lines.text: فإِن كان في الشمال ووجَدتَّ عرضه قد زاد فإِنّه صاعد وان وجَدْته قد نقَص فإِنّه هابط وان كان
lines.plain: فإِن كان في الشمال ووجَدتَّ عرضه قد زاد فإِنّه صاعد وان وجَدْته قد نقَص فإِنّه هابط وان كان

lines.text: عرضه في الجَنوب ووجدتَّ عرضه زائدًا فإِنّه هابط وإِن وجدتَّ عرضه قد نقَص فإِنّه صاعد. وان
lines.plain: عرضه في الجَنوب ووجدتَّ عرضه زائدًا فإِنّه هابط وإِن وجدتَّ عرضه قد نقَص فإِنّه صاعد. وان

lines.text: كان في الشمال ووجَدتَّه قد تَحَوَّلَ للجَنوب علِمْت أنّه كان في هُبوط الشمال وان كان في الجَنوب
lines.plain: كان في الشمال ووجَدتَّه قد تَحَوَّلَ للجَنوب علِمْت أنّه كان في هُبوط الشمال وان كان في الجَنوب

lines.text: ووجدتَّه قد تحوَّل الى الشمال علِمْتَ أنّه كان في صُعود الجنوب. فأمّا زُحَل والمُشْتَرِي والمِرِّيخ فإِنّ لهم
lines.plain: ووجدتَّه قد تحوَّل الى الشمال علِمْتَ أنّه كان في صُعود الجنوب. فأمّا زُحَل والمُشْتَرِي والمِرِّيخ فإِنّ لهم

lines.text: جهةً أُخْرَى يُعْلَم بها ذلك لهم وذلك أنّه اذا كان عرض احدهم في الشمال وكانت حاصّته اقلّ من{mL:5}
lines.plain: جهةً أُخْرَى يُعْلَم بها ذلك لهم وذلك أنّه اذا كان عرض احدهم في الشمال وكانت حاصّته اقلّ من

lines.text: {ov:قف} فهو صاعد وان كانت اكثر من {ov:قف} فهو هابط. وان كان عرضه في الجَنوب وكانت حاصَّته اقلَّ
lines.plain: قف فهو صاعد وان كانت اكثر من قف فهو هابط. وان كان عرضه في الجَنوب وكانت حاصَّته اقلَّ

lines.text: من {ov:قف} فهو هابط وان كانت اكثر من {ov:قف} فهو صاعد. وأمّا الزُّهَرَة وعُطارِد فلسُرْعة حركتهما حَوْلَ
lines.plain: من قف فهو هابط وان كانت اكثر من قف فهو صاعد. وأمّا الزُّهَرَة وعُطارِد فلسُرْعة حركتهما حَوْلَ

lines.text: الشمس وان{n:1} اكثر عرضهما يكون عند مُقَارَنَتهما لها يعسَر الوُقوف على حالهما إِلّا على الجِهة المتقدِّمة.
lines.plain: الشمس وان اكثر عرضهما يكون عند مُقَارَنَتهما لها يعسَر الوُقوف على حالهما إِلّا على الجِهة المتقدِّمة.

lines.text: في معرِفة طلوع الكواكب الخمسة المتحيِّرة وعُروبها وهو الظُّهور والاختفاء.
lines.plain: في معرِفة طلوع الكواكب الخمسة المتحيِّرة وعُروبها وهو الظُّهور والاختفاء.

lines.text: قال اذا اردتَّ أن تعلَم تشريق الكواكب وتغريبها وهو الطُّلوع والاختفاء فأمّا زُحَل والمشتري
lines.plain: قال اذا اردتَّ أن تعلَم تشريق الكواكب وتغريبها وهو الطُّلوع والاختفاء فأمّا زُحَل والمشتري

lines.text: والمِرِّيخ فإِذا كانت حاصّة كلّ واحد منهم من {ov:{0}} الى {ov:قف} فهو في{n:2} طُلوع الغَدَوَات ومن {ov:قف} الى {ov:شس}{mL:15}
lines.plain: والمِرِّيخ فإِذا كانت حاصّة كلّ واحد منهم من {0} الى قف فهو في طُلوع الغَدَوَات ومن قف الى شس

lines.text: فهو في{n:3} غُروب العَشِيَّات. وأمّا الزُّهَرَة وعُطارِدُ فلمَدارهما حَوْلَ الشمس وسُرْعة حَرَكتهما وإِبْطائهما
lines.plain: فهو في غُروب العَشِيَّات. وأمّا الزُّهَرَة وعُطارِدُ فلمَدارهما حَوْلَ الشمس وسُرْعة حَرَكتهما وإِبْطائهما

lines.text: يكون لهما عند الشمس اربعة أشْكال فأمّا الزهرة فإِنّه اذا كانت حاصّتها المعدَّلة من {ov:{0}} الى {ov:قلز}{n:3} فهي
lines.plain: يكون لهما عند الشمس اربعة أشْكال فأمّا الزهرة فإِنّه اذا كانت حاصّتها المعدَّلة من {0} الى قلز فهي

lines.text: في طُلوع العَشِيَّات وذلك حِينَ تُرَى على أُفْق المغرِب وهي عند ذلك اسْرَع حَرَكَةً من الشمس
lines.plain: في طُلوع العَشِيَّات وذلك حِينَ تُرَى على أُفْق المغرِب وهي عند ذلك اسْرَع حَرَكَةً من الشمس

lines.text: وهي من {ov:قلز} الى {ov:قف} *في غروب العَشِيّات وذلك حين تُبْطِئُ وترجِع وتلحَقها الشمس ومن {ov:قف} الى {ov:ركج}{mR:f. 120,r.}
lines.plain: وهي من قلز الى قف *في غروب العَشِيّات وذلك حين تُبْطِئُ وترجِع وتلحَقها الشمس ومن قف الى ركج

lines.text: في طُلوع الغَدَوَات وهي عند ذلك أبْطَأُ حركةً من الشمس ومن {ov:ركج} الى {ov:شس} تغرُب بالغَدَوَات حتَّى{mL:20}
lines.plain: في طُلوع الغَدَوَات وهي عند ذلك أبْطَأُ حركةً من الشمس ومن ركج الى شس تغرُب بالغَدَوَات حتَّى

lines.text: تلحَق الشمس وتختفِيَ بالشِّعاع وهي عند ذلك اسرَعُ حركةً من الشمس. ﴿ وأمّا عُطارد ﴾ فإِذا كانت
lines.plain: تلحَق الشمس وتختفِيَ بالشِّعاع وهي عند ذلك اسرَعُ حركةً من الشمس. ﴿ وأمّا عُطارد ﴾ فإِذا كانت

lines.text: حاصَّته المعدَّلة{n:4} من {ov:{0}} الى {ov:قيب} فهو يطلُع بالعَشِيَّات ومن {ov:قيب} الى {ov:قف} يغرُب بالعَشِيَّات ومن {ov:قف} الى
lines.plain: حاصَّته المعدَّلة من {0} الى قيب فهو يطلُع بالعَشِيَّات ومن قيب الى قف يغرُب بالعَشِيَّات ومن قف الى

notes.text: 1) Aut est مَعَ أَنَّ legendum, aut كان addendum et يكون postea delendum. — 2) Deest in
cod. — 3) Deest in cod. — 4) Cod. قلو — 5) Cod. المعتدله

observations: L01, L07, L11, L15: long joins (هابـط on L01; the first فهـو of L07; زُحَـل on L11; عنـد on L15) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of حَرَكتهما (L13) and of حَرَكَةً (L15).

The page ends chapter 47 and begins chapter 48. It has 19 lines and two lines of notes. L01 to L08 run the full measure (77 to 500 pt); L08 ends the chapter and is closed by a full stop. After a space stands the heading of chapter 48 on L09, in the larger type, centred (209.7 to 368.1 pt), and after another space its title on L10, centred as well (136 to 440 pt) and closed by a full stop. L11 to L19 run the full measure; L11, the first line of the chapter, is set in (it begins at 477 pt). Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the left margin beside L05, L09 (the heading), L12 and L17: they count the lines of the grid of the page, with the spaces about the heading and the title; the number 10 stands on the tenth line of the grid (its foot 7.5 pt over the baseline of the heading), and the title stands on the twelfth. The folio number «f. 120,r.» stands in the right margin beside L16, where the asterisk stands before في. Full stops stand on L02 after صاعد, on L04 after الجنوب, on L06 after هابط, on L07 after صاعد, on L13 after العَشِيَّات and on L18 after الشمس. Under a rule of 101 pt (77.0 to 178.2 pt) stand five notes in two lines, the first set in (105 to 500 pt), the second from the left edge (77 to 325 pt); no full stop closes them.
The brackets: on L18, after the full stop, the words وأمّا عُطارد stand between the two ornamental brackets (the sorts of the pages before).

Numerals in a smaller type under bars: {ov:قف} (180) twice on L06 (bars 13.2 and 12.6 pt), twice on L07 (13.2 pt each), twice on L12 (12.0 and 12.5 pt), twice on L16 (14.9 and 13.2 pt) and twice on L19 (13.0 pt each); {ov:شس} (360) on L12 (12.5 pt) and on L17 (13.0 pt); {ov:قلز} (137) on L14 (13.4 pt) and on L16 (13.2 pt); {ov:ركج} (223) on L16 (15.7 pt) and on L17 (15.4 pt); {ov:قيب} (112) twice on L19 (12.8 and 13.2 pt); and the zero, the sign of the codex, a small ring under a stroke, on L12 (13.0 pt), L14 (13.6 pt) and L19 (13.1 pt).

The note figures: the figure 1 stands on L08 after وان; the figure 2 on L12 after في; the figure 3 on L13 after في. After {ov:قلز} on L14 the figure printed is again «3» (4.3 x 6.5 pt), and after المعدَّلة on L19 the figure printed is «4» (4.3 x 6.5 pt), in both copies, where the notes 4 and 5 are meant: note 4 gives the reading of the codex for the numeral (قلو, 136) and note 5 its reading for المعدَّلة (المعتدله), and neither has another figure in the text. The two figures are transcribed as they are printed. The notes: for وان either مَعَ أَنَّ is to be read, or كان is to be added and the later يكون struck out; the word في is wanting in the codex on L12 and on L13. In note 1 مَعَ has a fatha over the mīm and a fatha over the ʿayn, and أَنَّ the hamza with a fatha over the alif and a shadda with a fatha over the nūn; يكون is printed with a long join.

L10 (the title): the print has «وعُروبها»: the second letter has no dot over it, in both copies, where غُروب on L13 and غروب on L16 have the dot of the ghayn; a damma stands over it (2.2 x 4.3 pt). Nallino's list of corrigenda gives «غُروبها» for this place (p. 176, line 12: the title stands on the twelfth line of the grid). The word is kept as printed. The other signs of the title: معرِفة: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); المتحيِّرة: a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under its two dots (3.2 x 2.2 pt), which stand on the foot of the join of the yā' and the rā'; الظُّهور: over the ẓā' a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 6.5 pt). L09 (the heading): no signs; والاربعون without a hamza.

L01: فإِن: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt). ووجَدتَّ: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt). فإِنّه (twice): the cluster under the alif (3.2 x 4.7 and 3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too twice on L02 (3.2 x 4.7 and 3.6 x 4.3 pt; 3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 2.5 pt). وجَدْته: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a ring in the second copy; the tā' has its two dots and no shadda (compare ووجَدتَّه on L03). نقَص: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too on L02 (3.6 x 2.2 pt). زاد, صاعد and وان: no signs.

L02: الجَنوب: a fatha over the jīm (4.0 x 2.2 pt); so too للجَنوب and الجَنوب on L03 (3.6 x 2.5 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt) and الجَنوب on L06 (3.6 x 2.2 pt); الجنوب on L04 has no signs. ووجدتَّ and وجدتَّ: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt; 3.2 x 2.5 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt); no fatha over the jīm (compare L01). زائدًا: the hamza over its tooth (2.5 x 3.2 pt) and the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt). وإِن: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt).

L03: ووجَدتَّه: a fatha over the jīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt); ووجدتَّه on L04 has the shadda and the fatha only (3.2 x 1.8 pt each). تَحَوَّلَ: a fatha over the tā', above its two dots (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt), over the wāw a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt), in both copies; تحوَّل on L04 has the shadda and the fatha over the wāw only (2.9 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt). علِمْت: a kasra under the lām (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.2 x 2.5 pt); no fatha over the tā' (compare L04). أنّه: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 pt); so too on L04 (2.5 x 2.9 and 2.9 x 2.2 pt) and on L05 (2.5 x 2.5 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt). هُبوط: a damma over the hā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt).

L04: علِمْتَ: a kasra under the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the mīm (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the tā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). صُعود: a damma over the ṣād (2.2 x 4.7 pt). فأمّا: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt). زُحَل: a damma over the zāy (2.2 x 4.3 pt) and a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt). والمُشْتَرِي: a damma over the mīm (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the three dots of the shīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt); the last letter has its two dots. والمِرِّيخ: a kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt), a shadda over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under it (3.2 x 2.2 pt). فإِنّ: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.6 x 2.5 pt). الى: no hamza; the last letter has no dots.

L05: جهةً: the fathatan over the two dots of the last letter (3.2 x 3.2 pt); no kasra. أُخْرَى: over the alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.1 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the khā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a ring in the second copy, and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt); the last letter has no dots. يُعْلَم: a damma over the yā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt). حاصّته: a shadda over the ṣād (3.2 x 2.5 pt), without a fatha (compare L06). اقلّ: a shadda over the lām (3.6 x 2.5 pt). اذا and احدهم: no hamza.

L06: حاصَّته: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 1.8 and 2.9 x 1.8 pt). اقلَّ: over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt) (compare L05). اكثر: no hamza; so too on L07 and on L08.

L07: وأمّا: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.5 pt); so too on L13 (2.9 x 3.2 and 2.9 x 2.2 pt) and on L18 (2.5 x 3.2 and 3.2 x 2.5 pt), and فأمّا on L14 (2.5 x 2.9 and 3.2 x 2.5 pt). الزُّهَرَة: over the zāy a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 6.5 pt), a fatha over the hā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too on L13 (the shadda 2.9 x 2.2 pt and the damma 2.5 x 4.3 pt apart; 4.0 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt); الزهرة on L14 has no signs. وعُطارِد: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 4.3 pt) and a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt). فلسُرْعة: a damma over the sīn (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). حركتهما: no signs (compare L13). حَوْلَ: a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a short fatha over the lām (2.5 x 1.8 pt); so too on L13 (3.6 x 1.8, 2.5 x 2.9 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L08: وان: no hamza and no signs; the figure 1 follows. مُقَارَنَتهما: a damma over the mīm (2.2 x 4.3 pt), a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the rā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt), in both copies; no sign over the tā'. يعسَر: a fatha over the sīn (3.2 x 1.8 pt). الوُقوف: a damma over the wāw (2.5 x 4.7 pt). إِلّا: under the alif the hamza (2.5 x 2.9 pt) with a kasra under it (3.2 x 1.8 pt), and a shadda over the lām-alif (3.6 x 2.5 pt). الجِهة: a kasra under the jīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt). المتقدِّمة: a shadda over the dāl (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under it (3.2 x 1.8 pt); the full stop follows.

L11: اردتَّ: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); no hamza. أن: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt). تعلَم: a fatha over the lām, printed in two small pieces (1.8 x 1.4 and 1.1 x 1.1 pt), in both copies. الطُّلوع: over the ṭā' a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 6.5 pt). فأمّا: a small hamza over the alif (1.8 x 2.2 pt) and a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt). زُحَل: a damma over the zāy (2.5 x 4.3 pt) and a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt). تشريق, وتغريبها, والاختفاء and والمشتري: no signs.

L12: والمِرِّيخ: a kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt), a shadda over the rā' (3.6 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under it (3.6 x 1.8 pt). فإِذا: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt); so too on L18 (3.2 x 4.3 pt). حاصّة: a shadda over the ṣād (3.2 x 2.5 pt); so too حاصّتها on L14 (3.2 x 2.5 pt). كلّ: a shadda over the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt). طُلوع: a damma over the ṭā' (2.2 x 4.3 pt); so too on L15 and on L17 (2.9 x 5.0 pt each); طلوع in the title has no signs. الغَدَوَات: a fatha over the ghayn, over the dāl and over the wāw (3.2 x 1.8, 2.5 x 1.8 and 2.9 x 1.8 pt); so too on L17 (3.2 x 1.8, 3.2 x 1.8 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt) and بالغَدَوَات on L17 (2.5 x 1.8, 2.9 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L13: غُروب: a damma over the ghayn, above its dot (2.9 x 5.0 pt); غروب on L16 has no signs. العَشِيَّات: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a kasra under the shīn (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (2.9 x 1.8 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt); so too on L15 (3.2 x 1.8, 3.6 x 1.8, 3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt) and بالعَشِيَّات twice on L19 (3.6 x 2.2, 3.6 x 1.8, 2.9 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.5 pt; 3.2 x 2.2, 3.6 x 1.8, 3.2 x 2.5 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt); العَشِيّات on L16 has the shadda without a fatha (3.6 x 2.2, 4.0 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 2.5 pt). وعُطارِدُ: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a damma over the dāl (2.2 x 4.7 pt). فلمَدارهما: a fatha low over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt, 6.1 to 8.3 pt over the baseline). وسُرْعة: a damma over the sīn (2.2 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). حَرَكتهما: a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt); no fatha over the long kāf (compare L15). وإِبْطائهما: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (2.9 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and the hamza over its tooth (2.5 x 3.2 pt).

L14: اربعة: no hamza. أشْكال: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a round sukun over the three dots of the shīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a ring in the second copy. فإِنّه: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt). المعدَّلة: over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt); so too on L19 (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt).

L15: حِينَ: a short kasra under the ḥā' (2.9 x 1.4 pt) and a fatha over the nūn (2.9 x 1.8 pt); حين on L16 has no signs. تُرَى: a damma over the tā' (2.2 x 5.0 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt); the last letter has no dots. أُفْق: over the alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 6.1 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a ring in the second copy. المغرِب: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt). وهي: the two dots of the yā' stand low under its bowl (9.0 to 10.8 pt under the baseline). اسْرَع: a round sukun over the sīn (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a ring in the second copy, and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt); no hamza (compare L18). حَرَكَةً: a fatha over the ḥā', over the rā' and over the long kāf (3.6 x 2.5, 3.6 x 2.5 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt) and the fathatan (4.0 x 3.2 pt); حركةً on L17 and on L18 has the fathatan only (3.6 x 3.2 pt each).

L16: تُبْطِئُ: a damma over the tā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a kasra under the ṭā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and over the last letter the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.8 pt). وترجِع: a short kasra under the jīm (2.9 x 1.4 pt). وتلحَقها: a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too تلحَق on L18 (3.6 x 2.5 pt).

L17: أبْطَأُ: the bare hamza over the first alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the ṭā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and over the last alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.8 pt). تغرُب: a damma over the rā' (2.5 x 5.0 pt). حتَّى: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt); the last letter has no dots.

L18: وتختفِيَ: a kasra under the fā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), whose two dots stand low. بالشِّعاع: a shadda over the three dots of the shīn (3.2 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the shīn (4.0 x 2.5 pt), in both copies. اسرَعُ: a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 4.7 pt); no sukun (compare L15). عُطارد: a damma over the ʿayn (2.2 x 4.7 pt).

L19: حاصَّته: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.2 and 4.0 x 2.2 pt); the figure «4» follows المعدَّلة. يطلُع: a damma over the lām (2.9 x 4.7 pt). يغرُب: a damma over the rā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt).
